Basic HTML text formatting:
Bold text using b tag
Strong text using strong tag
Italic text using i tag
Emphasized text using em tag
Underlined text using u tag
Strikethrough text using s tag
Strike text using strike tag
Text with subscript using sub tag
Text with superscript using sup tag
Bold and italic combined
Bold and underlined combined
Italic and underlined combined
Bold, italic, and underlined all combined
